rationale: B1 localized the defect to aggregate investment classification totals for 2025-12-31, including separate debt and equity investment totals and an overall total investment percentage. The requested correction class is classification_fix with mechanism classification_lookthrough. Because the cited evidence rows are aggregate total rows and do not provide an issuer_name or bdc_investment_identifier suitable for a holdings row_selector, this correction uses the narrow required asset_class template only and assigns the lookthrough asset class indicated by the debt investment total. Residual risk remains that the held-out gate may require issuer-level row selection or an equity-side companion correction that is not present in the embedded citations.
